summary.en: One word a beat on one anchor, each on its own ground opened from the previous word's dot; the answer stands on the accent field.
summary.zh: 同一锚点一拍一个词，每个词有自己的底色，从上一个词的墨点打开；答案站在强调色满底上。

fits: A hook of three words; a list of verdicts with the answer last.
notFor: words that need reading together; more than six words; phrases.

intent.en: Each word is a new page: the ground changes with the word, opened by the dot, so three words read as three hits.
intent.zh: 每个词都是新的一页：底色随词换，由墨点打开，三个词读起来像三下重击。

content.en: 2–6 single words (≤ 10 chars), optional grounds per word, an optional answer index.
content.zh: 2–6 个单词（每个 ≤ 4 字），可选每词底色，可选答案序号。

fits.zh: 三个词的开场钩子；最后一个是答案的一串结论。

notFor.zh: 要连起来读的词；超过六个词；短语。

en: All words share one size so the anchor never moves: a long word shrinks the others.
zh: 所有词共用一个字号，锚点不动：一个长词会让其他词一起变小。

overlaps.note: pulse: a question on a ramp with a query line; here paper/night grounds and the dot opens each

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
